# glitchtip_project_key (Resource)

A GlitchTip project key. Exposes the DSN clients send events with. `terraform import` identifier: `<organization_slug>:<project_slug>:<key_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glitchtip_project_key" "default" {
  organization_slug = glitchtip_organization.acme.slug
  project_slug      = glitchtip_project.checkout.slug
  name              = "default"
}

output "checkout_dsn" {
  value     = glitchtip_project_key.default.dsn_public
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_slug` (String) Slug of the organization the project belongs to. Changing this forces a new key.
- `project_slug` (String) Slug of the project this key belongs to. Changing this forces a new key.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Key label. Optional; GlitchTip assigns a default label when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `dsn_public` (String, Sensitive) Public DSN clients use to send events. Sensitive.
- `dsn_security` (String, Sensitive) Security-header reporting endpoint DSN. Sensitive.
- `id` (String) Key ID, assigned by GlitchTip.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import glitchtip_project_key.default acme:checkout-service:1
```
